config.title: Kodrix Agent OS
config.settings.markdownDescription: **Kodrix Settings** — Centralized management of all Kodrix configuration: codebase indexing & docs · AI providers · FIM completion · Embedding · Feature toggles
config.features.wikiAutoBuild.descriptio: Auto-generate Repo Wiki when workspace opens
config.features.kanban.description: Enable Agent Kanban board (Devin/Qoder Quest style)
config.features.agentRouter.description: Enable unified Agent OS smart router
config.features.arena.description: Enable Arena dual model comparison (Windsurf style)
config.features.acp.description: Enable ACP external agent integration (Devin Desktop style)
config.features.learning.description: Enable Learning Engine (gets smarter over time — cross-session knowledge distillation)
config.features.contextInjection.descrip: Auto-inject Wiki + Memory + Learning into Agent Instructions and Chat context
config.features.sessionLearning.descript: Auto-distill project knowledge when Agent session ends (Stop Hook + LLM)
config.sessionLearning.mode.description: Session learning mode: auto = auto-distill / prompt = ask for confirmation / off = disabled
config.sessionLearning.minUserMessages.d: Minimum number of user messages to trigger session learning (filter trivial sessions)
config.sessionLearning.autoInstallHook.d: Auto-install .github/hooks Session Learning Hook when workspace first opens
config.arena.modelA.description: Arena comparison model A (leave empty to use current default model)
config.experience.autoBootstrap.descript: Auto-bootstrap Agent context when workspace opens (Wiki · Memory · Learning · Hooks)
config.experience.showBootstrapTip.descr: Show Hub / Smart Router guidance tip on first workspace open
config.features.contextIntelligence.desc: Enable Context Intelligence (Wiki + Memory + Learning auto-inject into Chat)
config.features.semanticMemory.descripti: Enable semantic memory index (TF-IDF vector retrieval, zero external dependencies)
config.features.proactiveContext.descrip: Proactively suggest related Learning / Memory when opening files (status bar indicator)
config.router.autoExecute.description: Auto-execute when smart router has high confidence (no second confirmation needed)
config.features.agentCrew.description: Enable Agent Crew multi-agent collaboration orchestration (Devin / Cursor 3.0 style)
config.crew.maxParallel.description: Maximum concurrent tasks for Crew parallel execution (vs Cursor Subagent parallel dispatch, default 3)
config.features.vibeCoding.description: Enable Vibe Coding (build project from one sentence description)
config.features.ideaFlow.description: Enable Idea Flow — fully automated pipeline from idea to product. From vague idea to complete runnable app, AI handles analysis → planning → building → preview
config.hub.enableKeybinding.description: Enable Ctrl+Shift+H to open Kodrix Hub (disabling restores VS Code global replace shortcut)
config.features.codebaseIntelligence.des: Enable Codebase Intelligence — full-project semantic index (AST-level symbol/dependency/call-graph analysis)
config.features.predictiveCompletion.des: Enable context predictive completion — 'next edit' prediction based on full-project index
config.features.codebaseQuery.descriptio: Enable natural language code Q&A — @codebase query for definitions/references/architecture
config.codebase.autoIndexNewFolders.desc: Auto-index new folders: automatically index folders with fewer than 50,000 files (vs Cursor codebase indexing)
config.codebase.ignoreCursorignore.descr: Ignore files in .cursorignore: files to exclude from indexing besides .gitignore (vs Cursor)
config.codebase.grepIndex.description: Index repository for instant Grep (BETA): auto-index repo to accelerate Grep search, all data stored locally (vs Cursor)
config.features.terminalAI.description: Enable Terminal AI prompt bar — Cmd+K natural language command generation, Cmd+Enter to run (vs Cursor)
config.checkpoint.autoCapture.descriptio: Auto-capture version on file save (rolling, for rollback reference)
config.checkpoint.maxEntries.description: Maximum entries in auto-capture queue (oldest deleted after exceeding)
config.idea.autoExecute.description: Idea Flow build phase end-to-end auto-execution (auto-checkpoint before build, Crew auto-executes all tasks); disable to return to manual Agent per-task mode
config.modelRouter.enabled.description: Enable model auto-routing — auto-select model by task type (smart/balanced/fast) (vs Cursor multi-model routing)
config.tabCompletion.enabled.description: Enable Kodrix Tab completion (dedicated fast model channel, vs Cursor Tab). Disabled by default to avoid conflicts with upstream Copilot inline completion
config.agentLoop.maxIterations.descripti: Maximum iteration rounds for Agent reasoning loop (prevent runaway)
config.agentLoop.allowCommands.descripti: Allow Agent reasoning loop to execute terminal commands (run_command tool)
config.tabCompletion.mode.markdownDescri: Tab completion mode: **fim** = dedicated FIM completion channel (default DeepSeek FIM, requires API Key); **fast** = general model channel (no Key needed).
config.tabCompletion.fimProvider.markdow: FIM provider: **deepseek** = DeepSeek FIM (default endpoint); **custom** = custom FIM API (OpenAI-compatible completions format).
config.tabCompletion.fimEndpoint.markdow: FIM endpoint (fill in custom URL for custom provider).
config.tabCompletion.fimApiKey.markdownD: FIM API Key (DeepSeek Key or custom Key).
config.semanticEmbedding.enabled.markdow: Enable true vector semantic retrieval (Embedding). Must also fill in apiKey.
config.semanticEmbedding.apiKey.markdown: Zhipu (BigModel) API Key (https://open.bigmodel.cn). Auto-enables after saving.
config.agentLoop.checkpoint.description: Auto-create checkpoint before Agent runs, rollback all Agent changes
